preset.description:
Superspeedway 2 train setup for stock Daytona.
But works with many other versions of Daytona too. 
Side Drafting should make both lines about equal.

Inspired by 90's and 2000's Daytona racing, single and double file and possibly some breakaways at the front as tires wear. Optimized for stock Daytona + cup2003. To replicate on other versions of Daytona, adjust the grip so cars have to lift a little on worn tires.
No description for this preset. Edit this box to create one!
Inspired by 90's to early 2000's Talladega, spread out, disorganized pack racing. Bottom lane dominant up front but multiple lanes viable mid pack.

Full multigroove setup tuned for stock Atlanta, but often works on other versions of Atlanta.

Includes complete LP line data (race/min/max) so the AI cars use the full width of the corners.

Full multigroove setup tuned for stock California, but often works on other versions of California.

Includes complete LP line data (race/min/max) so the AI cars use the full width of the corners.

Full multigroove setup tuned for stock Chicagoland, but often works on other versions of Chicagoland.

Includes complete LP line data (race/min/max) so the AI cars use the full width of the corners.

Full multigroove setup tuned for stock Kansas, but often works on other versions of Kansas.

Includes complete LP line data (race/min/max) so the AI cars use the full width of the corners.

Increases AI drafting distance and lateral padding to spread cars out on track.

Sets:
  ai_drafting_distance = 4
  ai_dlat_pad = 3

All other settings unchanged.

Moves the AI race line toward the outside (high) groove.

Sets the race.lp blend slider all the way toward minrace (right side).
Min/max race line sliders stay at their default positions.

All other settings unchanged.

Moves the AI race line toward the inside (low) groove.

Sets the race.lp blend slider all the way toward maxrace (left side).
Min/max race line sliders stay at their default positions.

All other settings unchanged.

Forces all AI into a tight single-file high (outside) groove.

race.lp slider: all the way to minrace.
maxrace.lp slider: 95% toward minrace (nearly identical to race).

Only LP sliders are set — all other settings unchanged.

Forces all AI into a tight single-file low (inside) groove.

race.lp slider: all the way to maxrace.
minrace.lp slider: 95% toward maxrace (nearly identical to race).

Only LP sliders are set — all other settings unchanged.

AI drive like madmen with a high chance of wrecking. Designed for final-lap carnage.

Sets:
  yaw_accel_k1 = 0.1
  yaw_accel_k2 = 0.5
  ai_line_modifier = 1.07
  ai_drafting_distance = 0.0
  ai_dlat_pad = 1.0
  driver_consistency_to_left_offset_dev = 2.7
  mechanical_failure_interval = 50.0
  mechanical_failure_chance = 50.0

All other settings unchanged.

AI are nearly impossible to spin out, as if driving on rails.

Sets:
  yaw_accel_k1 = 0.5
  yaw_accel_k2 = 1.0

All other settings unchanged.

AI cars burn no fuel.

Sets:
  ai_fuel_use = 0.0

All other settings unchanged.

AI tires never wear out.

Sets:
  ai_tire_wear_left = 0.0
  ai_tire_wear_right = 0.0

All other settings unchanged.

AI cars will never suffer mechanical failures during the race.

Sets:
  mechanical_failure_chance = 0.0

All other settings unchanged.

AI cars will not collide with each other.

Sets:
  ai_wall_offset = 0.0

All other settings unchanged.
Generic Multigroove settings for left turning ovals. For ideal results, you will likely want to edit the lap files. Also consider the grip levels in Environment tab.
Ideal settings for Multigroove and Side Drafting combined, but generic to left turning ovals. For optimal results, you should consider editing lap files and grip settings on Environment tab.

Reduces AI grip to simulate cold tires on restarts.

NR2003 does not model cold tires for AI, so AI cars are unrealistically fast on the drop of the green while the human player struggles on cold rubber. Use this as a Restart preset in your lap triggers to level the playing field.

Sets:
  ai_grip_modifier = 0.95

All other settings unchanged.

AI cars will swerve back and forth a bit, as if drunk.

Useful for adding realism to cautions or chaos on green flag racing.

Sets:
  driver_consistency_to_left_offset_dev = 1.5

All other settings unchanged.

AI drive aggressively, bump drafting, swerving, and difficult to spin.

Sets:
  yaw_accel_k1 = 0.1
  yaw_accel_k2 = 0.5
  ai_line_modifier = 1.02
  ai_drafting_distance = 0.9
  ai_dlat_pad = 1.5
  driver_consistency_to_left_offset_dev = 2.5

All other settings unchanged.

AI cars never lift or check up: there is no slower speed target ahead of them to react to.

Raises the speed data in the lap files (the speed the AI aims for) on all three lines - minrace, race and maxrace - to at least 300 MPH, measured as the AI will actually drive it with your current opponent strength and ai_line_modifier. Points already faster than that are left alone.

Best on superspeedways. On a track with real corners the AI will not slow down for them and will wreck.

Only the lap files' speed data is changed; all other settings are unchanged. It is applied on top of whatever lap file edits are already loaded. Reset on the Presets tab, or a lap trigger reverting to baseline, puts the original lap files back.

Puts everything back to how the track loaded - exactly what the Reset button on the Presets tab does.

Every papy_ai.ini and track.ini setting goes back to the value the track started with, the lap files go back to the original lap files (any groove, edit or speed floor you loaded is undone), and every special mode and grip multiplier is turned off.

Like loading any preset, this only stages the values: click Apply All Tabs to write them to the game. Used as a lap trigger it applies automatically, so it makes a good 'back to normal' step after a preset that changed things for a stretch of the race.

Removes all the rubber buildup from the track - exactly what the Clean Track button next to Rubber Buildup on the Environment tab does, just without asking first.

Only the rubber is cleared: no setting, lap file or special mode changes, and Rubber Buildup stays on or off as it was. Loading it cleans the track right away (there is nothing to Apply). Used as a lap trigger it cleans the track when it fires, so it can put a fresh surface down at, say, the start of a new run. It is not repeated when other triggers are re-applied after a yellow, so the rubber laid since is kept.
